name: The Purpose Of The Woman
overview: Scripture reveals that the woman was created by God as a suitable helper for man, formed from his very flesh to complement and complete him (Genesis 2:18, 2:23). While the fall introduced sorrow and a divinely ordained order within marriage, the woman’s role includes wisdom, kindness, and compassionate care as exemplified in Proverbs 31:26 and Isaiah 49:15. The New Testament also shows women actively participating in teaching and strengthening the church, as seen in the example of Priscilla instructing others in the way of God (Acts 18:26). Together, these passages affirm the woman’s God-ordained purpose as helper, nurturer, and vital contributor to both family and faith community.
